'''Maltoria''' was an astronomical object that was located in the [[Maltorian system/Legends|Maltorian system]],<ref name="TJK" /> a part of the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was located near the [[Maltorian Mining Belt]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|282|Maltorian Mining Belt}}</ref>
